method: Raw STL exact welding; finite-volume actual-mesh occupancy intersections, even-odd local slices with all components and -0.4mm erosion; actual roof-normal rays (one grid-rib sample distinguished from five sheet-only samples). No repairs or thin exemptions.

tests.note: Tiny cropped sign fragments count even if an adjacent thicker member exists.

thin_warning: 0.83mm normal PC sheet, sign strokes, bolts, drain and grazing sections remain fragile. Elevated deck, roof, beams and truss webs require support planning; translucent display alpha does not alter solid STL.
limitations: Finite samples only, not a global minimum thickness/strength/bridge-span/slicer/support-removal or physical-print certification.
